name: Sanctified Gnoll

book: Kobold Quest From Ashes to Empire

body:
SANCTIFIED GNOLL
CR 10

XP 9,600
CE Medium humanoid (gnoll)
Init +2, Senses darkvision 60 ft.; Perception +13

DEFENSE

AC 24, touch 12, flat-footed 22 (+2 Dex, +6 armor, +6 natural)
hp 126 (11d10 +66)
Fort +13, Ref +5, Will +8
Immunities mind-affecting spells and effects

OFFENSE

Speed 30 ft.
Melee flail +20/15/10 (1d10 +10/19-20 plus bull rush)

STATISTICS

Str 26, Dex 15, Con 22, Int 9, Wis 8, Cha 12
Base Atk +11; CMB +18 (+20 bull rush), CMD 30 (32 vs bull rush)
Feats Improved Bull Rush, Power Attack

SPECIAL ABILITIES

Bull Rush (Ex)

When a strike is landed, the sanctified gnoll makes a bull rush attempt for free.

Unnerving Cackle (Ex)

Upon landing a critical hit or being struck by a critical hit, a sanctified gnoll may cackle. Doing so causes all enemies who can hear hi m within 60 feet to make a Will save. Those that fail become frightened until the start of the Sanctified Gnoll’s next turn.
